_comment: R446 - tracked model ids for the Graph-RAG engine (read by app/config.py).
Precedence, highest first: env var P2P_GRAPH_RAG_<FIELD> > this file > GraphRAGSettings field default.
Edit this file and merge to main to change the production model; Railway auto-deploys, no dashboard variable needed.
model = Stage-1 parse and auxiliary calls; stage2_model = Stage-2 answer; complex_model = complex tier, which also wins on the standard Stage-2 path.
An empty complex_model disables that swap. A non-Opus Stage-2 id is floored to Opus (R139).
claude-opus-5-5 needs Claude Code >= 2.1.280 on the wrapper host.
